player_prompt.intro:
Ou se Jwè {player_id} nan Chopsticks. Nan tòn ou, chwazi youn nan:
  + Atake:  '[attack M O]'  kote M=men ou (0 oswa 1), O=men advè (0 oswa 1).
    - Kont men advè a ogmante pa men ou; si >=5, li vin 0.
  + Separe:   '[split L R]'  pou redistribye tot dwa ou nan L ak R (L+R = tot ou).
Reponn ak eksakteman youn nan komand sa yo.

invalid_move.split_no_change: Split dwe chanje distribisyon men ou.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Mouvman envalide. Itilize “[attack M O]” oswa “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} atake men P{opp_id} {opp_idx}: li pase de {opp_val} a {new_val}.
